entity: Chronic late 10-K filers FY2023-FY2025 still exchange-listed: Laser Photonics, Global Interactive Technologies, BIO-key International, EON Resources (18-company cohort)

Global Interactive Technologies Nasdaq notice late Form 10-K
EON Resources NYSE American notice late annual report 10-K

sources.outlet: BIO-key International press release (SEC EDGAR exhibit 99.1)
sources.quote: failure to timely file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023
sources.searcher_note: BIO-key got a Nasdaq Rule 5250(c)(1) notice on April 17, 2024 for the late FY2023 10-K.

sources.quote: failure to timely file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025
sources.searcher_note: BIO-key late again for FY2025; Nasdaq notice, stock still listed. A June 10, 2026 follow-up says a late 10-Q sent it to a Nasdaq Hearing Panel.

sources.quote: the Company remains delinquent in filing its Form 10-K for the period ended December 31, 2024
sources.searcher_note: Laser Photonics' FY2024 10-K was still unfiled in late May 2025; Nasdaq delisting notice, exception window to Oct 13, 2025.

sources.outlet: Laser Photonics press release (SEC EDGAR exhibit 99.1)
sources.quote: On April 20, 2026, the Company filed the 2025 Form 10-K with the SEC, and on April 21, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed that the Company had regained compliance with the rule.
sources.searcher_note: Laser Photonics' FY2025 10-K was filed April 20, 2026, five days after the extended April 15 deadline; compliance regained the next day.

sources.outlet: Global Interactive Technologies press release (SEC EDGAR exhibit 99.1)
sources.quote: the Company did not timely file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 with the Securities and Exchange Commission
sources.searcher_note: GIT got a Nasdaq delinquency letter April 16, 2026 over its FY2025 10-K; a search snippet says the 10-K was filed May 26, 2026.

sources.quote: as a result of its failure to timely file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
sources.searcher_note: EON Resources got an NYSE American notice over its FY2025 10-K; it has until Oct 15, 2026 to file.

notes: Every source is a company's own disclosure of one year's late 10-K. None is press analysis, and no source lists these four, or the 18-company cohort, as late three years running. Multi-year lateness is shown only for BIO-key (FY2022, FY2023, FY2025 notices) and Laser Photonics (FY2024, FY2025). For GIT and EON only FY2025 was fetched. Extra sources not in the list: BIO-key FY2022 delinquency, SEC exhibit dated 2023-05-30, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1019034/000143774923016136/ex_527536.htm ('the Company remains delinquent in filing its Form 10-K for the period ended December 31, 2022'). GIT's late Q2 2026 10-Q got a Nasdaq notice Aug 20, 2026, per GlobeNewswire 2026-08-21: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/21/3349306/0/en/global-interactive-technologies-inc-announces-receipt-of-a-compliance-delinquency-notice-from-nasdaq.html. Pattern source: Hudson Labs, 2025-04-04, https://hudson-labs.com/post/nt-10-k-filings-trends-2025 ('22 companies, primarily micro caps, have filed their seventh consecutive NT 10-K (since our tracking began in 2019).'). It names none of the four. The 2026 NT 10-K trend query found no new 2026 aggregate coverage.
